entries.topic: Thin Ice for a machine Connor who killed Markus
originals: Thin Ice: only after Connor died in Crossroads, or also for a machine Connor who killed Markus?
entries.question: If a machine Connor survived Crossroads by shooting Markus, did Night of the Soul show Connor with Amanda in the snowy Zen Garden (THIN ICE)?
entries.why: template lock 'Connor stayed a machine or died in Crossroads' plus a machine-survivor variant (with Battle for Detroit string keys) vs wiki 'Only available if Connor died during Crossroads' and a PowerPyx reader; Thin Ice is one of the chapter's counted endings

originals: DON'T TRUST has no Jericho arrow?
entries.question: When Markus chose DON'T TRUST and shot Connor in the church, did a Jericho small-down arrow appear?
entries.why: template has no arrow; wiki Relationship_Stat gives Jericho small down; the option ends in Connor's death, where the reliability log found template arrows wrong twice

originals: Does Hank's House play, and Hank die, if Connor was deactivated in Last Chance or never reached Jericho?
entries.question: If Hank resigned in Last Chance, Connor and Connor was then decommissioned there, did Hank still end up dead (HANK COMMITTED SUICIDE on Night of the Soul's chart or Hank absent later)?
entries.why: template lock is only 'Hank was hostile ... and resigned'; Hank's House is a Connor scene, so the engine skips it when Connor is gone and Hank stays alive; no source covers the decommissioned case

entries.topic: Ousted Markus who left and Carl
originals: Does an ousted Markus who left still get the Carl scene?
entries.question: After Markus was ousted and chose LEAVE FOREVER in Crossroads, did Night of the Soul still open with Markus at Carl's house or grave?
entries.why: wiki: Pay Respects/Welcome Home 'if Markus is still alive' (silent on leaving); the engine blocks Markus scenes once markusActive is false

entries.topic: CHECK ON JOSH after an ousting
originals: CHECK ON JOSH: does a Josh who survived some other way (Markus ousted) unlock it?
entries.question: With Markus ousted (alive but gone) and Josh alive, was CHECK ON JOSH offered to deviant Connor in the church?
entries.why: PowerPyx 'Only if Markus died in Crossroads' vs wiki 'died during Crossroads after saving Josh'; the Connor template has no Josh section; neither covers the ousting
